test_smart_update_empty_cache: test that get_smart_dataset_update_plan raises SmartUpdateImpossibleBecauseCacheIsEmpty when the cache is empty
test_smart_update_same_revision: test that get_smart_dataset_update_plan returns no tasks when the cached revision matches the current revision
test_smart_update_revision_not_parent: test that get_smart_dataset_update_plan raises SmartUpdateImpossibleBecauseCachedRevisionIsNotParentOfNewRevision when the cached revision is not a parent
test_smart_update_empty_commit: test that an empty commit triggers an UpdateRevisionOfDatasetCacheEntriesTask to update cache entry revisions
test_smart_update_add_tag: test that adding a tag to the dataset card triggers an UpdateRevisionOfDatasetCacheEntriesTask without full recomputation
